provenance.rationale: Joins the explicitly named Iquitos Amazon destination and the Aria Amazon vessel in a concise cruise-day heading.

blocks.text:
At 07:10, transfer to the airport for your flight to Iquitos aboard a Gulfstream aircraft; the flight takes approximately 45 minutes.

On arrival, begin the four-day, three-night **AQUA EXPEDITION** programme with full board aboard the **Aria Amazon**.

The region is home to approximately 40,000 plant species, 427 mammal species, 1,300 bird species, 378 reptile species, more than 400 amphibian species and around 3,000 species of freshwater fish.

The Aria Amazon features 16 spacious, air-conditioned suites with panoramic windows and sitting areas. Facilities aboard include an outdoor jacuzzi, exercise facilities and massage rooms. Activities include kayaking, fishing and jungle excursions. Cuisine is overseen by chef Pedro Miguel Schiaffino, with premium drinks served on board.

Day 4 is devoted to exploring the jungle and observing wildlife. Day 5 includes kayaking excursions and piranha fishing.
